SCE.S:6DA054: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:6DA120: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:6DA1EC: A mutant turned pure energy. The universe ends where human senses end; he went past it.
SCE.S:6DA2B8: In the end, everyone must leave this world. He left by dying, not by passing through the "Catapult."
SCE.S:6DA384: To pass the "Catapult of Consciousness," one must clear all confusion of mind. She did.
SCE.S:6DA450: The mind left in her is like a tidy drawer. Her residual thoughts form a matrix.
SCE.S:6DA51C: Like looking into a mirror, all of you is reflected. Who "he" really was remains a mystery.
SCE.S:6ED198: {6}You've finally made it this far! ...I'm sorry, but... those of us here have reached the final stage of change. ...We will pass through the "Catapult of Consciousness" beyond here and depart for the next dimension. After several lives, I'm sure the day will come when you understand too. ...If interfering with us is what you truly wish, then first you must defeat me!
SCE.S:6ED4D0: Wait a second! ...A strong power is welling up from deep in my heart. "They" are inside me. "They" are changing me! It feels terrifying. It feels wonderful. I'm so confused I can't even walk. ...I'm sorry. ..... Go on alone from here! I'll manage somehow!
SCE.S:6ED7D4: Are you all right! {8}Fujita{2} came to the office, and the two of us followed you here from under the {7}hospital{2}. {8}Fujita{2} has taken your companion into protection. The {7}mine{2} is about to collapse. Let's get outside quickly!
SCE.S:6ED8F4: Are you all right! {8}Fujita{2} came to the office, and the two of us followed you here from under the {7}hospital{2}. The {7}mine{2} is about to collapse. Let's get outside quickly!
SCE.S:6EDA34: {6}I've glimpsed a wonderful world. I can't explain it in words to someone with perception like yours. Look behind me! That is the "Catapult of Consciousness." A shining, swirling road. In ancient times, those who landed on this land built a vortex of energy here. We completed it. It's still in the final adjustment stage. You must not go in. If an ordinary person like you enters, the whole balance will collapse. The road will be closed! Leave!
SCE.S:6EDD08: {1}The whole "Catapult of Consciousness" has begun to vibrate faintly. The road is closed. The mine is about to collapse!
SCE.S:6EDE40: {6}I will be the last to fight you. ......I am the other you, the one who has "changed"! To complete the Catapult, you and I only need to become one again. ...... The Catapult has started vibrating. ...If I defeat you, we can become one!
SCE.S:6EE054: {6}...The change in this "town" was brought by those who came from another world. They are a bank of "evolution." After we leave this world, they'll collect what they lent. They're not bad guys! I am what I am now thanks to them. Of course there were many victims. If the change spreads across the whole Earth, there will be even more victims. But... there's no going back. I'm leaving this world!
SCE.S:6EE260: {6}I told you to leave! Inside, energy swirls in a dangerous state. You are not suited for it. If you insist on going in, there's nothing I can do.
